name: Bond market volatility
summary: Treasury volatility index MOVE near 98.8 on 24 Nov, just below the 100 line; US 10-year yield 4.90%
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility closed near 98.8 on 24 Nov, edging below the 100 Watch line from about 101 on 23 Nov and 106 on 20 Nov (Yahoo Finance). The US 10-year yield ended near 4.90%, about 9bp lower over the month and well inside the 40bp line (Yahoo Finance). The data floor keeps Watch while MOVE sits at the boundary; no disorderly auction or emergency Fed action was found.
for_you: Bond-market swings feed into mortgage and borrowing rates. Volatility has eased slightly but remains near the top of its usual range.
rubric_hit: Watch kept at boundary: MOVE 98.8 just under 100; US 10y 1m move 9bp < 40bp
why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
